phases.objective: Preserve bounded no-secret HTTP and transport diagnostics when Main or Production policy readiness cannot complete Migration 1051 readback, without changing runtime authority or enabling any live mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The existing live activation readiness runner executes on the exact PR candidate.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Readiness evidence records only transport status, HTTP status, safe error code, and top-level response keys when Migration 1051 readback fails; credentials and response payloads remain excluded.
steps: Keep the existing x-api-key admin/service request contract unchanged.
Capture bounded no-secret failure metadata for the Migration 1051 readback assertion.
Guard the diagnostic fields with the existing policy contract test.
Run environment-impact and derived-state closure checks on the exact candidate.
Keep readiness read-only and leave Branch Protection, Rulesets, database, migration, grant, provider, and Production effects disabled.
assertions: The runner continues to send BACKEND_API_KEY through x-api-key.
No response body or credential value is written to evidence.
Environment impact is explicitly declared for staging and production.
Production mutation remains false and live staging certification remains required.
No Branch Protection or Rulesets Apply, migration, grant, SQL/DB mutation, provider mutation, credential payload read, force-push, or Production activation occurs.
